decisions.reason: As a close-to-core product in a growing niche, it still benefits from learning time and fit with existing hearing-related capabilities, though its limited prominence keeps withdrawal risk moderate if results stay below aspiration.
The thermoforming unit strengthens the firm's integrated workflow offer and uses established technical and production resources, so absent clear underperformance it is likely to be retained.

Because the orthopedic shoe last is distant from the firm's core medical-technology focus, weak fit and likely lower comparative performance make reallocation of resources to core businesses and nearer developments the more plausible choice.

The post-curing unit is close to the firm's digital production trajectory and can be carried for another year under organizational slack, but its lower website prominence suggests results may still be uncertain.
